# CMake Generation Specification

## 1. Root CMakeLists

Canonical shape:

```cmake
# Generated by cmakegen. DO NOT EDIT.
# Source: project.yml

cmake_minimum_required(VERSION 3.28)

project(
  MyApp
  VERSION 0.1.0
  LANGUAGES CXX
)

set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)

find_package(fmt 11 REQUIRED)

include(cmake/cmakegen.generated.cmake)

include(cmake/custom.cmake)
```

`project(... VERSION ...)` is omitted if no version exists.

Language order is stable: `C`, then `CXX`.

## 2. Generated target file

Use:

```text
cmake/cmakegen.generated.cmake
```

Reasons:

- keeps root CMakeLists short
- allows one renderer file to own target declarations
- makes generated vs custom code separation obvious

## 3. Target generation

Executable:

```cmake
add_executable(App)

target_sources(App
  PRIVATE
    Sources/App/main.cpp
)
```

Static library:

```cmake
add_library(Core STATIC)
```

Shared library:

```cmake
add_library(Core SHARED)
```

Interface library:

```cmake
add_library(Core INTERFACE)
```

## 4. Sources

Always explicit.

Sort lexicographically after normalization.

For normal targets:

```cmake
target_sources(Core
  PRIVATE
    Sources/Core/a.cpp
    Sources/Core/b.cpp
    include/Core/a.hpp
)
```

For interface library:

```cmake
target_sources(Core
  INTERFACE
    include/Core/a.hpp
)
```

MVP forbids implementation source extensions on interface libraries.

## 5. Include directories

```cmake
target_include_directories(Core
  PUBLIC
    include
  PRIVATE
    Sources/Core
)
```

Omit empty scopes.

## 6. Compile definitions

```cmake
target_compile_definitions(Core
  PRIVATE
    CORE_INTERNAL=1
)
```

## 7. Compile options

```cmake
target_compile_options(Core
  PRIVATE
    -Wall
)
```

Do not try to interpret compiler-specific flags in MVP.

## 8. Dependencies

```cmake
target_link_libraries(App
  PRIVATE
    Core
    fmt::fmt
)
```

## 9. Platform conditions

Render using native CMake conditions.

```cmake
if(APPLE)
  target_compile_definitions(Core
    PRIVATE
      CORE_MACOS=1
  )
endif()

if(WIN32)
  target_compile_definitions(Core
    PRIVATE
      NOMINMAX
  )
endif()

if(UNIX AND NOT APPLE)
  target_link_libraries(Core
    PRIVATE
      Threads::Threads
  )
endif()
```

Do not emit generator expressions for simple platform conditions in MVP.

## 10. Standards

Prefer target features instead of global standard variables.

C++:

```cmake
target_compile_features(Core PUBLIC cxx_std_23)
```

Executable default:

```cmake
target_compile_features(App PRIVATE cxx_std_23)
```

If a library exposes headers requiring the configured language standard, PUBLIC is preferred.

MVP simplifying rule:

- executable -> PRIVATE
- static/shared/interface library -> PUBLIC/INTERFACE as appropriate

C support may use `c_std_17`.

## 11. Presets

Generate schema-compatible `CMakePresets.json`.

Example:

```json
{
  "version": 8,
  "cmakeMinimumRequired": {
    "major": 3,
    "minor": 28,
    "patch": 0
  },
  "configurePresets": [
    {
      "name": "debug",
      "displayName": "Debug",
      "generator": "Ninja",
      "binaryDir": "${sourceDir}/build/debug",
      "cacheVariables": {
        "CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE": "Debug"
      }
    }
  ],
  "buildPresets": [
    {
      "name": "debug",
      "configurePreset": "debug"
    }
  ],
  "testPresets": [
    {
      "name": "debug",
      "configurePreset": "debug"
    }
  ]
}
```

Important implementation requirement:

The preset file version must be selected from the minimum supported CMake version, not hard-coded blindly. Keep this mapping in a dedicated compatibility module.

For the first MVP, you may choose a single supported minimum CMake release and document it clearly.

## 12. Formatting

Rules:

- 2-space indentation
- multiline command arguments
- one path/value per line when there are 2+ values
- no trailing spaces
- final newline
- stable ordering

No external formatter should be required.

## 13. Generated comments

Allowed:

- generated-file ownership header
- section headings

Avoid noisy comments repeating obvious code.

## 14. Idempotence

Running generation twice with no input changes must leave file hashes unchanged.
